verses.saheeh: I swear by this city, Makkah -
verses.khattab: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I swear (lā is extra) by this land, of Mecca,
verses.romanUrdu: Nahin mai kasam khata hoon is shehar(city) ki

verses.saheeh: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
verses.khattab: even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and you, O Muhammad (s), have free disposal of, sanction for, this land, in that you will be given permission to fight in it — and indeed God fulfilled this promise to him on the day of the Conquest [of Mecca] (thus this is a parenthetical statement intervening between that by which the oath has been sworn and that which is a supplement thereto).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haal yeh hai ke (Aey nabi) is shehar mein tumko halal kar liya gaya hai

verses.saheeh: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
verses.khattab: and by every parent and ˹their˺ child
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And [by] the begetter, that is, Adam, and that which he begat, that is, his descendants (mā, ‘that which’, [actually] means man, ‘whom’).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kasam khata hoon baap(Adam) ki aur us aulad ki jo ussey paida hui

verses.saheeh: We have certainly created man into hardship.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We certainly created man (al-insān: the generic noun) in travail, in [a state of] toil and hardship, struggling with the tribulations of this world and the calamities of the Hereafter.
verses.romanUrdu: Dar haqeeqat humne Insan ko mushakkat mein paida kiya hai

verses.uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
verses.indopak: اَيَحۡسَبُ اَنۡ لَّنۡ يَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ اَحَدٌ ۘ
verses.saheeh: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
verses.khattab: Do they think that no one has power over them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Does he suppose, does the strong man of Quraysh, namely, Abū’l-Ashadd b. Kalada, presume, on account of his strength, that (an: softened in place of the hardened form, its subject omitted, that is to say, annahu) no one will have power over him? Yet God has power over him.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya usne yeh samajh rakhha hai kay uspar koi qaabu na paa sakega

verses.saheeh: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
verses.khattab: boasting, “I have wasted enormous wealth!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He says, ‘I have exhausted, in enmity of Muhammad (s), vast wealth!’, great [wealth], piles and piles of it.
verses.romanUrdu: Kehta hai ke maine dhairon maal udaa diya

verses.saheeh: Does he think that no one has seen him?
verses.khattab: Do they think that no one sees them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Does he suppose that (an, in other words, annahu) no one has seen him?, with regard to what he has expended to know the quantity thereof; God knows the quantity thereof; but it is not [in reality that much so as] to be considered a great amount, and [in any case] He will requite him for his evil conduct.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya woh samajhta hai kay kisi ne usko nahin dekha

verses.saheeh: Have We not made for him two eyes?
verses.khattab: Have We not given them two eyes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have We not given (an interrogative meant as an affirmative, in other words, ‘We have [certainly] given’) him two eyes,
verses.romanUrdu: Kya humne usey do aankhein

verses.saheeh: And a tongue and two lips?
verses.khattab: a tongue, and two lips
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and a tongue, and two lips,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ek zubaan aur do honth nahin diye

verses.saheeh: And have shown him the two ways?
verses.khattab: and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and guided him to the two paths?, [did We not] point out to him the path of good and that of evil?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur dono numayan raste usey (nahin) dikha diye

verses.saheeh: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
verses.khattab: If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Yet why does he not assault the obstacle?, [why] does he [not] surmount it?
verses.romanUrdu: Magar usne dushwar guzar ghati(steep) se guzarne ki himmat na ki

verses.saheeh: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
verses.khattab: And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And what will show you, [what will] make known to you, what the obstacle is?, that he is to surmount — intended to emphasise its enormity (this statement is a parenthetical one). He explains the way to surmount it by saying:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tum kya jaano kay kya hai woh dushwar guzar ghaati

verses.saheeh: It is the freeing of a slave
verses.khattab: It is to free a slave
verses.jalalayn: ﻿the freeing of a slave, from bondage,
verses.romanUrdu: Kisi gardan ko gulami se chudana

verses.uthmani: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
verses.indopak: اَوۡ اِطۡعٰمٌ فِىۡ يَوۡمٍ ذِىۡ مَسۡغَبَةٍ ۙ
verses.saheeh: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
verses.khattab: or to give food in times of famine
verses.jalalayn: ﻿or to give food on a day of hunger,
verses.romanUrdu: Ya faake ke din

verses.saheeh: An orphan of near relationship
verses.khattab: to an orphaned relative
verses.jalalayn: ﻿to an orphan near of kin (maqraba means qarāba),
verses.romanUrdu: kisi qareebi yateem

verses.saheeh: Or a needy person in misery
verses.khattab: or to a poor person in distress
verses.jalalayn: or a needy person in misery (matraba: [literally means] ‘clinging to the dust [turāb]’ because of his poverty; a variant reading has two verbal nouns in place of the two verbs [fakka, ‘he freed’, and at‘ama, ‘he fed’], the first being in a genitive construction, fakku raqabatin, ‘the freeing of a slave’, and the second with nunation, it‘āmun, ‘to give food’, in which case there is an implied iqtihāmu before al-‘aqaba, of which the said reading becomes the explication);
verses.romanUrdu: Ya khaak nasheen miskeen ko khana khilana

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالۡمَرۡحَمَةِ ؕ
verses.transliteration: thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati
verses.saheeh: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
verses.khattab: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion
verses.jalalayn: while being (thumma kāna is a supplement to iqtahama, ‘he assaulted’; thumma is for the ordering of things to be mentioned) in other words, [what is meant is that] at the point of the assault he was: one of those who believe and enjoin one another to steadfastness, in [pursuing] obedience and in refraining from disobedience, and enjoin one another to compassion (marhama means rahma), towards creatures.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir (iske saath yeh kay) aadmi un logon mein shamil ho jo imaan laye aur jinhon ne ek dusrey ko sabr aur (khalq-e-khuda par) raham ki talqeen ki

verses.saheeh: Those are the companions of the right.
verses.khattab: These are the people of the right
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Those, the ones described by the said attributes, are the ones of the right [side] (al-maymana means al-yamīn).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log hain dayein baazu(right hand) waley

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا هُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡمَشۡـَٔـمَةِ ؕ
verses.transliteration: waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati
verses.saheeh: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
verses.khattab: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But those who disbelieve in Our signs, they are the ones of the left [side] (al-mash’ama means al-shimāl).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jinhon ne hamari aayat ko mann-ney se inkar kiya woh bayen bazu(left hand) waley hain

verses.saheeh: Over them will be fire closed in.
verses.khattab: The Fire will be sealed over them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Over them will be an enclosing Fire (read mu’sada or mūsada), closed on top [of them].
verses.romanUrdu: Un par aag chaayi hui hogi
